content.value: Fluid, GPU-accelerated transitions that feel alive on every device and every scroll.
Coverflow perspective and layered shadows give every panel real, tactile depth.
Typography-first composition that reads like a magazine spread on any screen.
One clean design that adapts from ultra-wide displays down to a single hand.
Power-cubic easing tuned frame by frame so every swipe feels deliberate.
Native drag, momentum, and keyboard navigation, all out of the box.
Every card, icon, and label is an independent element with its own Style panel.
Seamless infinite looping with autoplay that pauses the instant a visitor hovers.
Keyboard navigation, ARIA roles, and reduced-motion support built in from day one.
Drop it in, swap the images and copy, and the showcase is ready for production.
